stats table and QC plots

```{r}

dir <- getwd()
rpc <- fread(paste0(dir, "/sbrna_droplet_scRNAseq.readspercell.txt"))

rpc <- rpc[RG != "bad",]
rpc <- dcast(rpc, RG~type, fill = 0, value.var = "N")
rpc[,total_reads_per_cell := as.numeric(Ambiguity+Exon+Intergenic+Intron+Unmapped+User)][
        ,percent_exonintron := as.numeric((Exon+Intron)/total_reads_per_cell)][
              ,percent_intergenic := as.numeric(Intergenic)/total_reads_per_cell]

# human/mouse reads

rds <- readRDS(paste0(dir, "/sbrna_droplet_scRNAseq.dgecounts.rds"))
umiexall <- as.matrix(rds$umicount$exon$all)
# write.table(umiexall, gzfile("sbrna_droplet_scRNAseq.exon_umi_counts.mtx.gz"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE, col.names = NA)
readexall <- as.matrix(rds$readcount$exon$all)
# write.table(readexall, gzfile("sbrna_droplet_scRNAseq.exon_read_counts.mtx.gz"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = TRUE, col.names = NA)

complexity <- data.table(
  XC_NovaSeq = colnames(readexall),
  nGenes = colSums(readexall > 0),
  hs_reads = colSums(readexall[grep("ENSG",row.names(readexall)),]),
  mm_reads = colSums(readexall[grep("ENSMUS",row.names(readexall)),]),
  fract_hs_reads = colSums(readexall[grep("ENSG",row.names(readexall)),])/colSums(readexall),
  fract_mm_reads = colSums(readexall[grep("ENSMUS",row.names(readexall)),])/colSums(readexall)       
)

complexity[fract_hs_reads < 0.75 & fract_mm_reads < 0.75, species := "mixed"][
      fract_hs_reads >= 0.75 , species := "Human"][
      fract_mm_reads >= 0.75 , species := "Mouse"]

rpc_hsmm <- merge(rpc, complexity, by.x = "RG", by.y = "XC_NovaSeq")

# convert ENSEMBL-IDs to gene names

genenames <- fread(paste0(dir, "/sbrna_droplet_scRNAseq.gene_names.txt"))
genenames <- rbind(genenames,
                   data.table(
                     gene_id = row.names(readexall)[which(!row.names(readexall) %in% genenames$gene_id)],
                     gene_name = row.names(readexall)[which(!row.names(readexall) %in% genenames$gene_id)]
                   ))
genenames_match <- genenames[match(row.names(readexall),gene_id)]
genenames_match[duplicated(gene_name), gene_name:= paste0(gene_name,sample(genenames_match[duplicated(gene_name),.N], replace = F))]
row.names(readexall) <- genenames_match$gene_name
rownames(readexall)[rownames(readexall) == "generic_spike_3p"] <- "generic_sbRNA_3p"

# sbRNA and mitochondrial reads and fractions

mito_sbrna <- data.table( XC_NovaSeq = colnames(readexall),
                    mitoFrac = colSums(readexall[grep("^mt-|^MT-", row.names(readexall)),])/colSums(readexall),
                    n_reads_total_sbrna = readexall[grep("generic_sbRNA_3p", row.names(readexall)),],
                    sbrnaFrac = readexall[grep("generic_sbRNA_3p", row.names(readexall)),]/colSums(readexall))


rpc_hsmm_mito_sbrna <- merge(rpc_hsmm, mito_sbrna, by.x = "RG", by.y = "XC_NovaSeq")

ggplot(rpc_hsmm_mito_sbrna, aes(total_reads_per_cell, percent_exonintron*100)) +
  ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(show.legend = FALSE) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans="log10") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  xlab("n_reads") +
  ylab("percent_exon+intron") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3e04, linetype = "dashed") +  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 65, linetype = "dashed")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/QC_nreads_percentexonintron_scatterplot.pdf")

ggplot(rpc_hsmm_mito_sbrna, aes(total_reads_per_cell, percent_intergenic*100)) +
  ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(show.legend = FALSE) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans="log10") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3e04, linetype = "dashed") +  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 22, linetype = "dashed")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/QC_nreads_percentintergenic_scatterplot.pdf")

ggplot(rpc_hsmm_mito_sbrna, aes(total_reads_per_cell, mitoFrac*100)) +
  ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(show.legend = FALSE) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans="log10") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  xlab("n_reads") +
  ylab("percent_mito_reads") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3e04, linetype = "dashed") +  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/QC_nreads_percentmito_scatterplot.pdf")

ggplot(rpc_hsmm_mito_sbrna, aes(total_reads_per_cell, sbrnaFrac*100)) +
  ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity(show.legend = FALSE) + 
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans="log10") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  xlab("n_reads") +
  ylab("percent_sbRNA_reads") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3e04, linetype = "dashed")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/QC_nreads_percentsbrna_scatterplot.pdf")

ggplot(rpc_hsmm_mito_sbrna, aes(fill = species, x = hs_reads, y = mm_reads)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.33, shape = 21) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  xlab("Reads Human (species mix)") + 
  ylab("Reads Mouse (species mix)")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/scatterplot_mousehumanmixed.pdf")

filtered_bcs <- rpc_hsmm_mito_sbrna[total_reads_per_cell > 3e04 & percent_exonintron > 0.65 & percent_intergenic < 0.22 & mitoFrac < 0.20 & species != "mixed", RG]


# number of cells after QC filtering

length(filtered_bcs) # 1556

# median fraction of sbRNA reads of total sequenced reads

median(rpc_hsmm_mito_sbrna[,sbrnaFrac]) # 0.01225483

```

recover sbRNA reads

```{r}

# read in extracted sbRNA reads as extracted using UMIcountR (see umicountR.Rmd)

sbRNA_reads <- fread(paste0(dir, "/sbrna_droplet_scRNAseq.extracted.sbrna.dat.csv.gz"))

# recover reads with max hamming distance 2

max_dist <- 2

sbRNA_seq_mapping <- data.table(
  sbRNA_seq = c("TATTATTTCTTTCA", # 3
               "TCTTTATTGTTTAC", # 20
               "AAAGGGTAATATGT", # 27
               "TTGTCTTTGTATTG", # 36
               "TTTTTATGTTAGTA", # 52
               "TAATTTCCTTTAAT", # 31
               "TTTAAATCAGTTGC"), # 54
  sbRNA_id = c("sbRNA-3",
              "sbRNA-20",
              "sbRNA-27", 
              "sbRNA-36", 
              "sbRNA-52", 
              "sbRNA-31", 
              "sbRNA-54")
)

dists <- stringdistmatrix(sbRNA_reads$sbRNA_UMI, sbRNA_seq_mapping$sbRNA_seq, method = "hamming", nthread = 4)

dists_long <- melt(dists, value.name = "distance", )
setDT(dists_long)
setnames(dists_long, c("readidx", "sbRNA_idx", "distance"))
setorder(dists_long, distance)
dists_long <- dists_long[, .SD[1], by = "readidx"]

dists_long <- dists_long[distance < (max_dist+1)]

sbRNA_seq_mapping[, sbRNA_idx := seq(.N)]
dists_long <- merge(dists_long, sbRNA_seq_mapping, by = "sbRNA_idx")
sbRNA_reads[, readidx := seq(.N)]
sbRNA_reads <- merge(sbRNA_reads, dists_long, by = "readidx")

# remove cells that were excluded based on initial QC

sbRNA_reads_filtered <- sbRNA_reads[BC %in% filtered_bcs,]

```

sbRNA stats

```{r}

# number of molecules per sbRNA per cell

colors <- c(
      "sbRNA-20" = "#F8766D",
      "sbRNA-27" = "#C49A00",
      "sbRNA-3" = "#53B400",
      "sbRNA-31" = "#00C094",
      "sbRNA-36" = "#00B6EB",
      "sbRNA-52" = "#A58AFF",
      "sbRNA-54" = "#FB61D7",
      "Doublet" = "#7F7F7F",
      "Negative" = "#D3D3D3"
      )

sbRNA_counttable <- sbRNA_reads_filtered[, .(molPC = uniqueN(UB)), by = .(BC, sbRNA_id)]
sbRNA_counttable[,total_sbRNA_mol_per_cell := sum(molPC), by = BC]
sbRNA_counttable[,fraction := molPC/total_sbRNA_mol_per_cell]

setorder(sbRNA_counttable, -molPC)
sbRNA_counttable_top2 <- sbRNA_counttable[, .SD[1:2], by = "BC"]
sbRNA_counttable_top2[, diff := molPC[1] - molPC[2], by = "BC"]
sbRNA_counttable_top2[, ratio := molPC[1]/molPC[2], by = "BC"]
sbRNA_counttable_top1 <- sbRNA_counttable_top2[, .SD[1], by = BC] # extract highest scoring sbRNA
sbRNA_counttable_top1[, sbRNA_filtered := ifelse(diff != 0, sbRNA_id, NA)] # remove equal counts for 2 top sbRNAs

# density plot top sbRNA counts

ggplot(sbRNA_counttable_top1[!is.na(sbRNA_id)], aes(x = molPC, fill = sbRNA_id)) +
  geom_density(position = "stack", alpha = 0.8, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 100, 1000),labels = c("1", "5", "10", "100", "1000")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  #scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
  labs(x = "Top sbRNA counts per cell",
       y = "Density",
       title = "Stacked density of top sbRNA counts")
```

Seurat clustering and UMAP

```{r}

meta_filter <- as.data.frame(rpc_hsmm_mito_sbrna[RG %in% filtered_bcs])
rownames(meta_filter) <- meta_filter$RG
meta_filter$RG <- NULL

# convert ENSEMBL-IDs to gene names (UMI counts)

genenames <- fread(paste0(dir, "/sbrna_droplet_scRNAseq.gene_names.txt"))
genenames <- rbind(genenames,
                   data.table(
                     gene_id = row.names(umiexall)[which(!row.names(umiexall) %in% genenames$gene_id)],
                     gene_name = row.names(umiexall)[which(!row.names(umiexall) %in% genenames$gene_id)]
                   ))
genenames_match <- genenames[match(row.names(umiexall),gene_id)]
genenames_match[duplicated(gene_name), gene_name:= paste0(gene_name,sample(genenames_match[duplicated(gene_name),.N], replace = F))]
row.names(umiexall) <- genenames_match$gene_name
rownames(umiexall)[rownames(umiexall) == "generic_spike_3p"] <- "generic_sbRNA_3p"

seuob <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(counts = umiexall[,filtered_bcs], project = "WGA_10x", meta.data = meta_filter)

FeatureScatter(seuob, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
seuob <- Seurat::SCTransform(seuob, seed.use = 42)
seuob <- RunPCA(seuob, seed.use = 42)
ElbowPlot(seuob, ndims = 50)
seuob <- FindNeighbors(seuob, dims = 1:20)
seuob <- FindClusters(seuob, random.seed = 42)
seuob <- RunUMAP(seuob, dims = 1:20, seed.use = 42)

DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_clusterID.pdf")

DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap", group.by = "species")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_species.pdf")
```

souporcell assignment

```{r}
soup <- fread(paste0(dir, "/sbrna_droplet_scRNAseq.clusters.tsv"))

soup_used <- soup[barcode %in% filtered_bcs] # keep only expected barcodes
soup_used <- soup_used[assignment %in% c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)]
soup_used$assignment <- paste0("donor",soup_used$assignment)

soup_sum <- soup_used[, .(count = .N), .(assignment)]
snp_assignments <- soup_used[!(assignment %in% c("doublet", "unassigned")), c("barcode", "assignment")]
setnames(snp_assignments,"assignment", "assignment_souporcell")

snp_assignments <- as.data.frame(snp_assignments)
rownames(snp_assignments) <- snp_assignments$barcode
snp_assignments$barcode <- NULL
seuob <- AddMetaData(seuob, metadata = snp_assignments)

DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap", group.by = "assignment_souporcell")

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_souporcell.pdf")

# rename split Seurat clusters based on souporcell identity

seuob$merged_clusters <- as.character(seuob$seurat_clusters)
seuob$merged_clusters[seuob$merged_clusters %in% c("1", "4", "7")] <- "1"
ordered_clusters <- names(sort(table(seuob$merged_clusters), decreasing = TRUE))
seuob$merged_clusters <- match(as.character(seuob$merged_clusters), ordered_clusters) - 1
seuob$merged_clusters_label <- paste0("c", seuob$merged_clusters)

DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap", group.by = "merged_clusters_label", label = T, repel = TRUE)

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_seuratclusters_merged.pdf")

# label clusters with merged cluster ID

p <- DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap", group.by = "assignment_souporcell",label = F)

p +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = data.frame(
      Embeddings(seuob, "umap"),
      cluster = seuob$merged_clusters
    ) |>
      dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        UMAP_1 = median(umap_1),
        UMAP_2 = median(umap_2)
      ),
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = paste0("c", cluster)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    color = "#8F8F8F",
    fontface = "bold",
    force = 5,
    point.padding = 2
    
  )

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_souporcell_withclusters_merged.pdf")

# souporcell assignments per merged Seurat cluster

soc <- copy(seuob@meta.data)
setDT(soc, keep.rownames = T)

soc_counts <- soc[, .(n_cells_label = .N), by = c("merged_clusters_label", "assignment_souporcell")]
soc_totals <- soc[, .(n_cells_group = .N), by = "merged_clusters_label"]
soc_plot <- merge(soc_counts, soc_totals, by = "merged_clusters_label")
soc_plot[, fraction := n_cells_label / n_cells_group]

ggplot(soc_plot, aes(x = factor(merged_clusters_label), y = fraction * 100, fill = assignment_souporcell)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    labs(y = "percentage", x = "merged cluster") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)) +
    coord_flip()

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/bars_cellline_souoporcell.pdf")
```

cell line annotation

```{r}

# read DepMap info

ccle <- fread(paste0(dir,"/resources/OmicsExpressionTPMLogp1HumanProteinCodingGenes.csv"))

ccle <- ccle[IsDefaultEntryForModel == "Yes"]

gene_cols <- names(ccle)[!(names(ccle) %in% c(
  "ProfileID",
  "ModelID",
  "V1",
  "SequencingID",
  "ModelConditionID",
  "IsDefaultEntryForModel",
  "IsDefaultEntryForMC"
))]

clean_names <- gsub(" \\(.*\\)", "", gene_cols)

anyDuplicated(clean_names) # no duplicated gene names

names(ccle)[names(ccle) %in% gene_cols] <- clean_names
expr <- as.data.frame(ccle)
rownames(expr) <- expr$ModelID

expr <- expr[ ,
    !(names(expr) %in%
      c("V1",
        "SequencingID",
        "ModelID",
        "ModelConditionID",
        "IsDefaultEntryForModel",
        "IsDefaultEntryForMC"))
]

expr <- t(as.matrix(expr))

# correlate pseudobulk per cluster with reference RNA-seq data for human cell lines

seurat_human <- subset(seuob, subset = species == "Human")
human_cluster_ids <- unique(seurat_human$merged_clusters_label)

# make pseudobulk per cluster

pb <- AggregateExpression(
    seurat_human,
    assays = "RNA",
    group.by = "merged_clusters_label",
    return.seurat = FALSE
)$RNA

# normalize pseudobulk to compare to normalized ccle expression data (gene length not accounted for in pseudobulk normalization)

pb_cpm <- t(t(pb) / colSums(pb) * 1e6)
pb_log <- log2(pb_cpm + 1)

cor_to_ccle <- function(cluster_vec, expr_matrix) {

    common <- intersect(names(cluster_vec), rownames(expr_matrix))

    cluster_vec <- cluster_vec[common]
    expr_matrix <- expr_matrix[common, , drop = FALSE]

    cors <- apply(
        expr_matrix,
        2,
        function(x)
            cor(
    cluster_vec,
    x,
    method = "spearman",
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)
    )

    sort(cors, decreasing = TRUE)
}

# add model info

models <- fread(paste0(dir,"/resources/Model.csv"))

results_list <- list()

for (cl in colnames(pb_log)) {

    message("Processing cluster: ", cl)

    cors <- cor_to_ccle(pb_log[, cl], expr)

    hits <- data.frame(
        ModelID = names(cors),
        correlation = as.numeric(cors)
    )

    hits <- merge(
        hits,
        models[, .(
            ModelID,
            CellLineName,
            OncotreeLineage,
            OncotreePrimaryDisease
        )],
        by = "ModelID",
        all.x = TRUE
    )

    hits <- hits[order(-hits$correlation), ]
    hits$cluster <- cl

    results_list[[cl]] <- hits
}

results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# get highest scoring cell line across cell lines

setDT(results, keep.rownames = T)

plot_dt <- results[
    CellLineName %in% c("THP-1", "MDA-MB-231", "MCF-7", "A549", "HEK-293") |
        grepl("^IMR-", CellLineName),
    .(cluster, CellLineName, correlation)
]
plot_dt[CellLineName == "IMR-32", CellLineName := "IMR-32 (IMR-5)"]

ggplot(plot_dt,
       aes(x = CellLineName,
           y = factor(cluster),
           fill = correlation)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    labs(
        x = "Expected cell line",
        y = "Cluster",
        fill = "Spearman\ncorrelation"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/heatmap_celllines.pdf")

plot_dt[, cluster := as.integer(sub("^c", "", cluster))]

# select top correlating cell line per cluster; adjust annotation of IMR-32 which was used as closest approximation for IMR-5 (not present in reference)

best_hits <- plot_dt[order(plot_dt, -correlation), .SD[1], by = cluster]
best_hits[CellLineName == "IMR-32", CellLineName := "IMR-5"]

seuob$cellline <- best_hits$CellLineName[
    match(as.character(seuob$merged_clusters_label),
          as.character(paste0("c", best_hits$cluster)))]

# identify mouse cell lines based on marker genes

markers_list <- list(
  "B16" = c("Pmel", "Mlana", "Mitf", "Slc45a2"),
  "4T1" = c("Epcam", "Krt8", "Krt18", "Krt19"),
  "MPC" = c("Phox2a", "Slc18a1", "Ret", "Phox2b", "Th", "Dbh", "Scg5")
)

missing_cells <- is.na(seuob$cellline)

seuob <- AddModuleScore(
  object = seuob,
  features = markers_list,
  name = "cellline_score")

colnames(seuob@meta.data)[
  grep("cellline_score", colnames(seuob@meta.data))
] <- names(markers_list)

cluster_scores <- seuob@meta.data |>
  dplyr::group_by(merged_clusters_label) |>
  dplyr::summarise(across(names(markers_list), mean))

cluster_assignments <- cluster_scores |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(B16, `4T1`,MPC),
    names_to = "predicted_cellline",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  group_by(merged_clusters_label) |>
  slice_max(
    order_by = score,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  ungroup()

cluster_map <- setNames(cluster_assignments$predicted_cellline, as.character(cluster_assignments$merged_clusters_label))
predicted <- unname(cluster_map[as.character(seuob$merged_clusters_label)])
missing <- is.na(seuob$cellline)
seuob$cellline[missing] <- predicted[missing]

cellline_plots <- VlnPlot(
  seuob,
  features = names(markers_list),
  group.by = "merged_clusters_label",
  combine = FALSE,
  fill = names(markers_list)
)

cellline_plots

# Map(function(p, nm) {ggsave(filename = paste0("./pdfs_man/vlnplot_", paste(nm, collapse = "_"), ".pdf"), plot = p, width = 13, height = 7, units = "cm")}, cellline_plots, names(markers_list))

p2 <- DimPlot(seuob, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cellline", label = F)

p2 +

    data = data.frame(
      Embeddings(seuob, "umap"),

    ) |>
      dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        UMAP_1 = median(umap_1),
        UMAP_2 = median(umap_2)
      ),
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = paste0("c", cluster)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    color = "#8F8F8F",
    fontface = "bold",
    force = 5,
    point.padding = 2
    
  )
```

add sbRNA info to seurat

```{r}

sb_mat <- dcast(
  sbRNA_counttable,
  sbRNA_id ~ BC,
  value.var = "molPC",
  fill = 0
)

rownames <- sb_mat$sbRNA_id
sb_mat <- as.matrix(sb_mat[, sbRNA_id := NULL])
rownames(sb_mat) <- rownames

# add as its own assay to Seurat object

identical(colnames(seuob), colnames(sb_mat))
seuob[["HTO"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(counts = sb_mat)

DefaultAssay(seuob) <- "HTO"
seuob <- NormalizeData(seuob, assay="HTO", normalization.method="CLR", margin=2)


seuob <- HTODemux(seuob, assay="HTO", positive.quantile=0.99)

colors <- c(
      "sbRNA-20" = "#F8766D",
      "sbRNA-27" = "#C49A00",
      "sbRNA-3" = "#53B400",
      "sbRNA-31" = "#00C094",
      "sbRNA-36" = "#00B6EB",
      "sbRNA-52" = "#A58AFF",
      "sbRNA-54" = "#FB61D7",
      "Doublet" = "#7F7F7F",
      "Negative" = "#D3D3D3"
      )

seuob$hash.ID <- factor(
  seuob$hash.ID,
  levels = names(colors)
)

DimPlot(seuob, group.by="hash.ID", cols = colors, pt.size=.5)

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_sbRNAs.pdf")

# assignment stacked bar plots

md <- copy(seuob@meta.data)
setDT(md, keep.rownames = T)

md[,n_cells_cellline := .N, by = "cellline"]
md[,n_cells_sbRNA := .N, by = c("cellline", "hash.ID")]
md[,fraction_sbRNA := n_cells_sbRNA/n_cells_cellline]


md_plottable <- unique(md[,c("cellline", "hash.ID", "fraction_sbRNA")])
md_plottable[, stack_order := NA_real_]
md_plottable[!is.na(hash.ID), stack_order := rank(-fraction_sbRNA, ties.method = "first"), by = cellline]
md_plottable[is.na(hash.ID), stack_order := Inf]

# set cell line order

cellline_order <- md_plottable[hash.ID != "Negative", .(max_sbRNA_fraction = max(fraction_sbRNA, na.rm = TRUE)),
                               by = cellline][order(-max_sbRNA_fraction),cellline]

md_plottable[,cellline := factor(cellline, levels = cellline_order)]

ggplot(md_plottable, aes(x = cellline, y = fraction_sbRNA*100, fill = hash.ID)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(x = "cell line", y = "percentage") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors)
```

assignment comparisons 

```{r}

exp_sbRNA <- data.table(
  cellline = c("A549","HEK-293","MCF-7","IMR-32 (IMR-5)","B16","THP-1","MDA-MB-231","4T1","MPC"),
  expected_sbRNA = c("sbRNA-36","sbRNA-3","sbRNA-20","sbRNA-27","sbRNA-31","Negative" ,"sbRNA-54","sbRNA-54","sbRNA-52")
)
sbRNA_ex <- merge(md, exp_sbRNA, by = "cellline", all.x = T)

sbRNA_ex[, assignment := ifelse(
  expected_sbRNA == "Negative",            # if expected sbRNA is Negative:
    ifelse(
      hash.ID == "Negative",               # and assigned sbRNA is Negative
      "correct",                           # then mark as correct
      "wrong"                              # otherwise mark as wrong
    ),
  ifelse(                                  # if expected sbRNA is NOT Negative:
    hash.ID == "Negative",                 # if assigned sbRNA is Negative
    "unassigned",                          # then mark as unassigned
    ifelse(
      hash.ID == expected_sbRNA,           # otherwise if assigned sbRNA is same as expected
      "correct",                           # then mark as correct
      ifelse(
        hash.ID == "Doublet",              # otherwise if assigned sbRNA is Doublet
        "doublet",                         # then mark as doublet
        "wrong")                           # otherwise (if assign sbRNA is other sbRNA than expected) mark as wrong
      )
    ))]

assdt <- sbRNA_ex[,.(
    n_all = .N,
    n_correct = sum(assignment == "correct", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_wrong = sum(assignment == "wrong", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unassigned = sum(assignment == "unassigned", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_doublet = sum(assignment == "doublet", na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = cellline][,`:=`(
    fraction_correct = n_correct / n_all,
    fraction_wrong = n_wrong / n_all,
    fraction_unassigned = n_unassigned / n_all,
    fraction_doublet = n_doublet / n_all,
    fraction_singlet = (n_correct+n_wrong)/n_all
  )]

# fraction correctly assigned

mean(assdt[cellline != "THP-1", fraction_correct]) # 0.8377726
assdt[cellline == "MPC", fraction_correct] # 0.9666667
assdt[cellline == "B16", fraction_correct] # 0.5777262

# fraction correctly assigned THP-1 (unlabeled)

assdt[cellline == "THP-1", fraction_correct] # 0.9534884

# fraction correctly assigned 4T1, MDA-MB-231

assdt[cellline == "4T1", fraction_correct] # 0.8333333
assdt[cellline == "MDA-MB-231", fraction_correct] # 0.8820225

# mean accuracy across labeled cell lines

mean(assdt[cellline != "THP-1", fraction_correct]) # 0.8377726
```

sbRNA distributions

```{r}

sbRNA_ctseu <- merge(sbRNA_counttable, md[,c("rn","cellline")], by.x = "BC", by.y = "rn")

# set order of sbRNA stacking

rna_order <- sbRNA_ctseu[, .(mean_fraction = mean(fraction, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(cellline, sbRNA_id)]
rna_order[, stack_rank := rank(-mean_fraction, ties.method = "first"), by = cellline]

sbRNA_ctseu[rna_order, stack_rank := i.stack_rank, on = .(cellline, sbRNA_id)]

cell_order <- dcast(
  sbRNA_ctseu,
  cellline + BC ~ stack_rank,
  value.var = "fraction",
  fill = 0
)

rank_cols <- setdiff(names(cell_order), c("cellline", "BC"))
rank_cols <- rank_cols[order(as.integer(rank_cols))]

setorderv(cell_order, cols = c("cellline", rank_cols), order = c(1L, rep(-1L, length(rank_cols))))
cell_order[, CellOrder := seq_len(.N), by = cellline]

sbRNA_ctseu[cell_order, CellOrder := i.CellOrder, on = .(cellline, BC)]

ggplot(sbRNA_ctseu, aes(x = CellOrder, y = fraction*100, fill = sbRNA_id, order = fraction, group = interaction(cellline, BC, stack_rank))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  labs(x = "cells", y = "percentage") +
  facet_wrap(~cellline, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colors)
```

fraction of top sbRNA counts of total cell umi counts

```{r}

sbrna_cts <- sbRNA_ctseu[,c("BC", "sbRNA_id", "molPC")]
setnames(sbrna_cts, c("BC", "sbRNA_id"), c("rn", "HTO_maxID"))

sbrna_cts_sub <- sbrna_cts[md[, .(rn, HTO_maxID)], on = .(rn, HTO_maxID), nomatch = 0]

sbrna_cts_sub <- as.data.frame(sbrna_cts_sub)
rownames(sbrna_cts_sub) <- sbrna_cts_sub$rn
sbrna_cts_sub$rn <- NULL
seuob <- AddMetaData(seuob, metadata = sbrna_cts_sub)

seuob@meta.data$sbRNA_fraction_of_total_UMIs <- seuob@meta.data$molPC/seuob@meta.data$nCount_RNA
seuob@meta.data$sbRNA_fraction_of_total_UMIs_log <- log10(seuob@meta.data$sbRNA_fraction_of_total_UMIs)

global_min <- floor(min(seuob$sbRNA_fraction_of_total_UMIs_log, na.rm = TRUE))
global_max <- ceiling(max(seuob$sbRNA_fraction_of_total_UMIs_log, na.rm = TRUE))

# all sbRNAs in one UMAP

FeaturePlot(seuob, 
            features = "sbRNA_fraction_of_total_UMIs_log", 
            reduction = "umap",
            min.cutoff = global_min,
            max.cutoff = global_max
            ) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "#E6D5F5",      # light purple
    high = "#5B0A91",     # dark purple
    na.value = "grey80",
    limits = c(global_min, global_max),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Fraction of total UMIs (log10)",
    breaks = c(global_min, (global_min + global_max) / 2, global_max)
  )

# ggsave("./pdfs_man/UMAP_fraction_sbRNAcounts_oftotalcounts_log.pdf")

# one UMAP per sbRNA

sbRNA_ctseu_long <- dcast(
  sbRNA_ctseu,
  BC ~ sbRNA_id,
  value.var = "molPC"
)

# add to Seurat meta data
sbRNA_ctseu_long <- as.data.frame(sbRNA_ctseu_long)
rownames(sbRNA_ctseu_long) <- sbRNA_ctseu_long$BC
sbRNA_ctseu_long$BC <- NULL
seuob <- AddMetaData(seuob, metadata = sbRNA_ctseu_long)

cols <- names(seuob@meta.data)[grep("sbRNA-", names(seuob@meta.data))]
seuob@meta.data[, paste0(cols, "_fraction")] <-
  seuob@meta.data[, cols, drop = FALSE] / seuob@meta.data$nCount_RNA
cols_frac <- names(seuob@meta.data[paste0(cols, "_fraction")])
seuob@meta.data[paste0(cols_frac, "_log10")] <-
  lapply(seuob@meta.data[cols_frac], log10)

# plot for all sbRNA counts

global_min <- floor(min(seuob@meta.data[paste0(cols_frac, "_log10")], na.rm = TRUE))
global_max <- ceiling(max(seuob@meta.data[paste0(cols_frac, "_log10")], na.rm = TRUE))

plots_all <- lapply(cols_frac, function(sb) {
  
FeaturePlot(
    seuob,
    features = paste0(sb, "_log10"),
    reduction = "umap",
    min.cutoff = global_min,
    max.cutoff = global_max
    ) +
    ggtitle(sb) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "#E6D5F5",
    high = "#5B0A91",
    na.value = "grey80",
    limits = c(global_min, global_max),
    oob = scales::squish,
    name = "Fraction of total UMIs (log10)",
    breaks = c(global_min, (global_min + global_max) / 2, global_max)
  )
})

plots_all
```
